key_terms.التَّظُّم: Grievance or complaint of being wronged
key_terms.قُرَيْش: The Quraysh, the prominent tribe of Mecca

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's complaint against the Quraysh in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) formal complaint against the Quraysh, specifically highlighting their deviation from the Prophet’s Sunnah and their monopolization of political power during the early Caliphate. It sets the stage for the detailed enumeration of their 'excesses' (Tafaddul), which Shia scholars view as the root cause of the subsequent political schism and the loss of rightful leadership (Imamate).
